description: Add a fully authored content-plan entry with an exact title, target keyword, summary, content type, funnel stage, and date; the supplied fields are not AI-reinterpreted. Without scheduled_date, the entry is placed after the latest active plan. status=APPROVED makes it eligible for the daily scheduler; the default DRAFT status does not.

project_id.description: MotiBlog project id permitted by the current credential. Omit when a default project is configured.

scheduled_date.description: ISO 8601 date; omitted = appended after the latest plan

target_keyword.description: Search phrase to target (metrics are enriched automatically)

name: create_content_plan
title: Create Content Plan
